title: Saudi point-of-sale spending, Q4 2022 vs Q4 2021

attempts.text: Saudi Arabia's point-of-sale card spending (SAMA) experienced a significant increase in Q4 2022 compared to Q4 2021, with an average weekly POS value of SAR 11.01 bn, up by 14.6% year over year. This marked a 32.8% increase in transactions from Q4 2021, which was SAR 115.5 million. The increase in transactions is attributed to a 32.8% increase in the average weekly value, which was SAR 1,679 mn. The other figures show a similar increase in the average weekly POS value and transactions, with the largest movers (by size of change) being Other (up) and Miscellaneous Goods and Services (up).

final_text: Average weekly point-of-sale spending in Saudi Arabia was SAR 11.01 bn in Q4 2022, up 14.6% from SAR 9.60 bn in Q4 2021. Average weekly transactions were 153.4 million (up 32.8%), and the average ticket was SAR 71.8 (down 13.7%). The largest movements were: Other increased by SAR 336 mn; Miscellaneous Goods and Services increased by SAR 276 mn; Beverage and Food increased by SAR 247 mn.
